Message:
I can hear footsteps...
If it’s an assassin
aiming for me, then...

I must set Moineau free...
I can’t let her meet
the same fate as those birds...

“It may not have been very long,
but I’ll always treasure
the time we had spent together.
Thank you so much...”

Even if your
being a butler was a lie,
our time together
brought me great joy...

I’m fine...
This is simply my fate...

“You really are a liar
to the end, aren’t you?”

It’s a fitting end for a witch
who never allowed herself
to wake from a dream
drenched in lies, is it not?

Suddenly,
Moineau knelt before me,
and held up something round...
An old...silver coin...?

“Please wait here.
I will surely come back for you.
This is the proof of my promise.”​
But, another promise is...
“I will not abandon you, my lady.”

...! I know it’s wrong of me...
It’s wrong of me, but...!

“Moineau...
please, don’t get hurt...”

This...will be the last time...
So, I beg you...!
Let me believe, just this once...!

That you’ll keep this promise...
That you’ll come back for me,
no matter what...!

That I...deserve to keep living...
That I deserve to be loved...
So, please...!

“I have come for you,
my lady...”
...! Thank you...Moineau...!
